[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: KanekoaTheGreat (@KanekoaTheGreat); megjelent: 2026-11-06T18:50:51+00:00; link: https://x.com/KanekoaTheGreat/status/2118778153711935662; média: videó, 109 másodperc]
Ron Baron asked Elon Musk how many CEOs live on site in an Airstream and work hands-on with everyone.

MUSK: “Airstreams are actually pretty nice... It’s parked right next to the power plant.”

“We built this power plant that’s producing over a gigawatt... in about a year, as opposed to normally about five years.”

“There is no upstairs.”

He walks the entire site up to five times a day. He’s pulled power cables “the size of an anaconda,” run fiber, wired switches, and worked on the power plant software.

“I try to do at least a little bit of everything, so that I’m not numb to the pain of the people who are actually doing it.”

“It’s not as though I’m sitting in an office and somebody has to come to me. I’m walking the floor, asking them questions actively.”

There’s a reason SpaceX is winning the compute race.
